100% JS Compatible

JugaadLang compiles cleanly to raw ECMAScript and runs directly on the V8 engine without any intermediary VM bottlenecks.

Hindi Native Syntax

Write code in your native language! From `agar` to `ghumo`, everything is mapped naturally to Hindi terms.

Blisteringly Fast

Executes at exactly the same speed as native JavaScript. Test results show 35th Fibonacci in 89ms.
